source.citation: F. Scaramuzzino, C. Carmicino, G. Festa, A. Viviani, A. Russo Sorge, 'Paraffin-based and metal-loaded HTPB fuel regression-rates study in a lab-scale hybrid rocket fed with N2O', 5th EUCASS, Münih, 2013

units_original: mm, kg/(m^2 s), kg/s, bar, mm/s, m/s (Tablo A1/A2; C* birimi kaynakta hatalı 'mm/s' basılı)
